These are sourced reports, not a live equipment inventory. Each report shows its evidence grade, age and review status. A board manufacturer or video system does not identify a timekeeper console.

“Controller confirmed” describes what the cited report names; it does not mean the current equipment was inspected. Contributed reports show independent source review as pending. Board-only and procurement records do not receive simulator links.
